Hi Sarah — thanks for the clarity. A couple quick notes on DocuSign routing and the notarized page: 

1) DocuSign supports parallel signing for the Order Form; we can set signer order to "parallel" so procurement + finance sign at the same time.
2) For the MSA notarization: DocuSign does not itself notarize physical pages. Typical flow we use:
   - Redwood sends the full MSA via DocuSign for signature (signature fields for Redwood rep + Acme rep).
   - Acme obtains a physical notarized signature page locally, scans it, and returns the scanned page to the DocuSign envelope (as an uploaded attachment) or emails it to us.
   - Redwood will then merge that scanned notarized page into the final MSA clean PDF and produce the consolidated executed PDF for Acme.

3) We can add an explicit "Attach Notarized Page" instruction in the envelope and include a required upload field so Acme can upload the scanned notarized page directly into DocuSign (preferred). If they prefer to email it, we'll accept that but it delays automated merging.

Please confirm:
- Signer names (full name + title) who will sign for Acme.
- Whether Acme can upload the notarized page into the envelope (preferred) or will email the scan.

Once confirmed I'll create the envelope and share the link + envelope id.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Contracts Ops
Redwood Inference
